cleared.check: Task 1 (L-1238), all 128 terminators of the 128 un-entered value blocks: Jump 84, JumpI 31, Return 6, FallThrough 4, Stop 3. For each block the cycle 31 hook state logged before the terminator (research/network-risk/cycles/031/theme-monad-gcc-real-states.work/out/states.jsonl, record w=t) was laid out as the gcc 15.2.0 build reads the Stack, deferred comparison included, and the package's whole emit function ran in the cycle 27 x86 model: Emitter::jumpi(Block const&) 0x394df0 with a model Block for the fall-through block (offset +0x28, terminator +0x18, instruction vector +0x0/+0x8, read from the dispatch at 0x394dff to 0x394f2f), Emitter::jump() 0x392400, fallthrough() 0x382980, return_() 0x383060 and stop() 0x36f0f0, with every function of their direct-call closure interpreted from the package text (jumpi_keep_fallthrough_stack 0x3949c0, jumpi_spill_fallthrough_stack 0x3944d0, jumpi_comparison 0x36f500, conditional_jmp 0x36f430, both discharge_deferred_comparison, write_to_final_stack_offsets 0x3816e0, adjust_by_stack_delta<false> 0x399180 and <true> 0x399270, jump_stack_elem_dest, non_literal_jump_dest_operand, jump_non_literal_dest 0x391d30, jump_dest_label 0x36f240, jump_literal_dest, return_with_status_code 0x382c90, mov_stack_elem_to_unaligned_mem<true>, missing_spill_count and the allocators). The Emitter fields these read were set as the code reads them: epilogue label +0x238, error label +0x248, engaged jump table label +0x258/+0x268, keep_stack_in_next_block_ +0x3e0, bytecode_size_ +0x4a4 = 24009, and the jump destination map +0x4a8 (std::unordered_map<size_t, Label>, nodes next/key/Label) holding the 610 JUMPDESTs of the runtime. BaseAssembler::newLabel 0x637530 and bind 0x637650 were recording stubs. The cycle 29 operand decoder dropped the index scale of asmjit memory operands (signature bits 16 and 17); it was fixed, so the jump table load reads [rax+r*4]. Streams were compared with the clang listing body of the terminator with exact rbp and rsp displacements, exact immediates, exact block labels and the condition code, registers and local labels renamed by first appearance (scripts/term.py strict).
cleared.result: All 128 gcc streams equal the clang listing. Conditional jumps emitted: jne 18, jnb 12, jnz 12, je 10, jae 1, jb 1, jl 1; the jnb and jnz pairs are the range checks of the 12 jumps through the jump table, the other 72 jumps go to a literal block label. The 31 JUMPI terminators split into 17 with a materialised condition and Equal 7, Equal negated 4, Below negated 1, Below 1, GreaterEqual negated 1; 16 keep the fall-through stack in registers and 15 spill it, 14 of them because the fall-through block is a JUMPDEST. At 2 blocks the clang listing uses a limb order of a register row that the hook log does not carry; with the order read from the listing the gcc stream is equal. No terminator stopped on an assertion or left the closure.

cleared.check: Task 2 at the terminator: each of the 128 streams ran in the x86 model 2000 times (seed 3333), 256000 runs in all. Label targets were resolved to exits (block label, error label, epilogue, a jump table whose entry d holds 16*d for a JUMPDEST and the error label otherwise, fall through). A deferred comparison's flags came from operand pairs on the edge of a 256-bit compare (equal, one below, one above, top limb equal with lower limbs different, sign bit set on one side, zero, a single limb differing) for the first quarter of the runs and from random pairs after that; elements holding the comparison got the 0 or 1 the flags mean. Jump destinations were JUMPDESTs 60 percent of the time and otherwise 24009, 24008, 0, a JUMPDEST plus one, a JUMPDEST with bit 64, 128, 192 or 255 set, or a random word; materialised conditions were 0, 1, all ones, 2^64, 2^128, 2^192, 2^255 or random. The reference successor is the EVM rule of pyevm.py's JUMP and JUMPI arms (tools/opdiff/pyevm.py, lines listed in out/term.json pyevmJumpArms). For the taken side the words at rbp + 32*i for every index left on the stack, rbp moved by 32 times the block delta and the stack size counter [rsp+48] moved by the delta were checked; for a kept fall-through every location the Stack records for each element; for RETURN the offset and size words at [rbx+192] and [rbx+224] and the status word. A second run (SYNTH=1, out/term-synth.json) put each of the 10 Comparison codes, positive and negated, on each of the 14 logged JUMPI states that carry a deferred comparison and drove all 16 flag states in turn, 22400 runs.
cleared.result: No run chose a different successor and no successor word, rbp, counter, result word or status differed: 0 bad runs of 256000, and 0 of 22400 in the synthetic run, so every condition code and its negation is emitted and taken as the comparison means, including the signed ones that no logged state carries.

cleared.check: Task 2, whole blocks: the FullMath.mulDiv blocks 0x5757, 0x57ca, 0x5860, 0x588a, 0x58d6, 0x58db and the mulDivRoundingUp remainder block 0x51cf. Every code-emitting instruction was emitted by the package's own emit function from its logged state and the terminator by the same functions as above, the limb table threaded from site to site as the Emitter does (a literal shift by 128 renames limbs, so the table at the terminator of 0x5757 differs from the one at its entry). The concatenated stream was compared with the clang listing of the block body, then run from the block entry state with the package's runtime helpers serving every helper call, and compared with pyevm.py run on the block's own bytecode from the same entry stack: the successor and every stack word at block exit. 20,000 operand sets per block (seeds 3334), a third of them with an entry word rewritten so that a word the block compares (the GT of remainder and prod0, the LT of mm and prod0, the GT of prod1 and the denominator at FullMath.sol:30, the EQ at :33) is equal to, one above, one below, equal in the top limb to, or zero against the other, and a third with the multiplicand of the MULMOD made a multiple of the modulus. scripts/edgecheck.py traced 3,000 more sets per block the same way to count which edges are reached.
cleared.result: All seven concatenated streams equal the clang listing, and all 140,000 runs give the successor and every exit word pyevm.py gives (0 bad runs). At 0x588a the branch is require(denominator > prod1) of FullMath.sol:30: it jumps to 0x330 (JUMPDEST PUSH0 DUP1 REVERT) through jae, and took that side in 3527 of the 20,000 runs; edgecheck found the GT operands equal in 83 and one apart in 139 of 3,000 sets. At 0x58d6 the prod1 == 0 test of :33 jumps to 0x593c (the div(prod0, denominator) return) in 1367 runs, with the EQ operands equal in 225, one apart in 419 and equal in the top limb only in 650 of 3,000. At 0x51cf the remainder test of :112 took the rounding side in 6460 runs, with the remainder zero in 962 of 3,000. Each JUMPI side, both MULMOD remainder cases and the denominator equal to, one below and one above prod1 were reached.

cleared.result: All 253 streams equal the clang listing. At 5 MSTORE sites (0x417, 0x421, 0x487, 0x491, 0x4c6) the listing skips the memory bound check because the offset element was already checked; that is StackElem::touched_memory_size_ (block +0x80, read by touch_memory<V> at 0x395694), which the cycle 31 hook does not log; with it set to 32 the gcc stream is equal. The 203 MLOAD and MSTORE calls are the memory growth call (cmp dword ptr [rbx+264], end; jae; mov or lea rdi; call qword ptr [ROD]) with no spill before it, the same in both builds; the routine it reaches, monad_vm_runtime_increase_memory_raw_v1 and _mip3, is byte-equal to the harness (cycle 27) and its trampoline was read in cycle 29. SIGNEXTEND: 20,000 runs, 0 mismatches.

cleared.check: Task 4: planted faults, each a one-line change to the package text in the model or to the model's data, run through the same checks: block:cc-jae-as-jb (240 runs, 60 bad, 1 blocks flagged); block:dc-discharged-after-flags-reused (240 runs, 93 bad, 2 blocks flagged); block:lt-gt-compare-operands-swapped (240 runs, 101 bad, 2 blocks flagged); block:successor-rbp-shift-16 (240 runs, 63 bad, 3 blocks flagged); term:cc-jae-as-jb (7680 runs, 60 bad, 1 blocks flagged); term:cc-jne-as-je (7680 runs, 1080 bad, 18 blocks flagged); term:cond-test-skips-low-limbs (7680 runs, 117 bad, 8 blocks flagged); term:cond-test-skips-top-limb-live (7680 runs, 16 bad, 1 blocks flagged); term:dc-left-in-flags-at-jumpi (7680 runs, 240 bad, 4 blocks flagged); term:jumpdest-map-shifted (7680 runs, 5533 bad, 103 blocks flagged); term:keep-path-no-negation (7680 runs, 840 bad, 14 blocks flagged); term:successor-rbp-shift-16 (7680 runs, 4243 bad, 79 blocks flagged).
cleared.result: Every fault was caught: an inverted condition code (jae as jb, jne as je), the keep path without negation, a condition test that skips the low limbs or the top limb, a wrong successor rbp (shl 4 for shl 5 in adjust_by_stack_delta), a deferred comparison left in the flags at the JUMPI, a shifted jump destination map, compare operands swapped in the LT and GT emitter, and a deferred comparison discharged after SUB has reused the flags. An unsaved live register around a keccak or sload call could not be planted, because those emitters are inlined into compile_basic_blocks<traits> and were not driven.

cleared.check: Whether this theme applies to the other 20 networks.
cleared.result: It does not. The terminators, memory emitters and block streams examined here are those of Monad's native compiler, which only Monad's validators run. The other networks execute the PoolManager in their own interpreters, whose jump, comparison and memory handling OPCODES.md checks 1 to 4 cover. Nothing in this unit changes a result for them.

cleared.check: The source lines whose branches these blocks hold, read in this repository: FullMath.mulDiv computes prod0 and prod1 by mulmod with not(0) and sub (src/libraries/FullMath.sol:21-26), requires denominator > prod1 (:30), returns div(prod0, denominator) when prod1 == 0 (:33-37), otherwise subtracts the remainder, factors out twos and multiplies by the Newton inverse (:46-99); mulDivRoundingUp adds one when mulmod(a, b, denominator) != 0 and requires the sum to be non-zero (:111-114).
cleared.result: The text does what its comments say. With the branches at :30, :33 and :112 emitted and taken as pyevm.py takes them on Monad's shipped build, no ordinary account can make mulDiv skip the overflow revert, take the 256-bit division on a 512-bit product, or drop a rounding unit.

leadResults.answer: The shipped JUMPI, JUMP, FallThrough, RETURN and STOP emitters ran on the logged states of all 128 un-entered value blocks and equal the clang listing exactly (condition code, compare operands, targets, rbp and counter adjustments, final stack offsets). 256,000 terminator runs, 22,400 runs over all 10 comparison codes and 16 flag states, and 140,000 whole-block runs of the six mulDiv blocks and the rounding block matched pyevm.py, with each branch side at FullMath.sol:30, :33 and :112 reached and the denominator equal to and one either side of prod1.

381 of the 473 sites ran from the package with equal streams: the 128 terminators and 253 memory, context and SIGNEXTEND sites (SIGNEXTEND also on 20,000 value runs). The 92 KECCAK256, SLOAD, SSTORE, TLOAD and LOG sites are emitted by inlined templates and were not run; a lead records them.
